Successfully added the Baseball.mp3 audio file to your presentation!

**What was done:**
1. Opened the Insert menu in LibreOffice Impress
2. Selected "Audio or Video..." option
3. Navigated to the Desktop folder
4. Selected the Baseball.mp3 file (7.3 MB, 8:17 duration)
5. Clicked Open to insert the audio into the presentation
6. Saved the presentation (Ctrl+S)

**Result:**
The audio file now appears as a music note icon on slide 1 (the title slide) of your baseball presentation. The Media Playback properties panel is available on the right side, allowing you to:
- Play, pause, or stop the audio
- Adjust the seek position
- Control the volume
- Modify the position and size of the audio icon

The audio is now embedded in your presentation and will play during your slideshow when you reach slide 1.
